milestones: Construction sites and traffic changes active in 2026
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Piazza della Libertà–Arno–Bagno a Ripoli corridor; final track and stop geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Florence Tram Line 3.2.2 to Rovezzano
properties.agency: Comune di Firenze / Tram di Firenze
properties.timeline: The Piazza della Libertà–Rovezzano extension has a definitive project and delivery agreement approved at the end of 2025.
properties.description: Florence’s Line 3.2.2 will extend the eastern tram network from Piazza della Libertà toward Rovezzano and the eastern rail corridor.
milestones: Executive design and works delivery being arranged
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Piazza della Libertà–Rovezzano corridor; final alignment and stop geometry remain subject to detailed design.

properties.name: Seville Metro Line 3 North
properties.agency: Junta de Andalucía / Agencia de Obra Pública
properties.timeline: The northern section from Pino Montano through San Lázaro and Macarena to Prado is under construction, with works active across multiple sections in 2026.

milestones: More than half of the route in execution
Utility crossings and tunnel works active in 2026
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Pino Montano–San Lázaro–Macarena–Prado corridor; the underground alignment and station geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Málaga Metro Line 2 to Hospital Civil
properties.agency: Junta de Andalucía / Metro de Málaga
properties.timeline: The Line 2 extension from Guadalmedina to Hospital Civil is being built in three sections, with construction continuing in 2026.

milestones: Tunnel works active in Calle Hilera
2026 program continues construction toward Hospital Civil
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Guadalmedina–Hospital Civil corridor; underground alignment and station geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Granada Metro South Extension
properties.agency: Junta de Andalucía / Metro de Granada
properties.timeline: The southern extension toward Churriana de la Vega and Armilla is being completed alongside 2026 planning for future network expansions.
properties.description: Granada’s metro is extending south through Armilla toward Churriana de la Vega, adding service to growing suburban districts south of the city.

2026 works focus on completion and commissioning
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Granada centre–Armilla–Churriana de la Vega corridor; final track and stop geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Alcalá de Guadaíra Tramway
properties.agency: Junta de Andalucía / Agencia de Obra Pública
properties.timeline: The 4.7 km, 10-stop tramway is in final signaling, electrification, finishing, and depot works in the 2026 program.
properties.description: The Alcalá de Guadaíra tram will connect the town centre and university corridor with the Seville Metro Line 1 interchange at Pablo de Olavide.
milestones: Signaling and electrification works scheduled for completion
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Pablo de Olavide–Alcalá de Guadaíra corridor; final track and stop geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Crossrail 2
properties.agency: Transport for London / Department for Transport
properties.timeline: The proposed regional railway would link Surrey and Hertfordshire through a new north–south tunnel under central London; design development remains paused while the route is safeguarded.
properties.description: Crossrail 2 is a protected long-term regional rail project connecting Wimbledon and suburban Surrey with Tottenham Hale and New Southgate in north-east London.
milestones: Construction powers and funding not yet authorized
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Wimbledon–central London–Tottenham Hale/New Southgate corridor; the safeguarded route remains subject to future revision.

properties.name: DLR Beckton Riverside–Thamesmead Extension
properties.timeline: The proposed cross-river extension from Gallions Reach through Beckton Riverside to Thamesmead is being developed for a Transport and Works Act application in 2027.
properties.description: The DLR extension would add a new station at Beckton Riverside and a tunnel under the Thames to a new Thamesmead station, connecting two major east-London growth areas.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Gallions Reach–Beckton Riverside–Thamesmead corridor; river crossing and station geometry remain subject to consent.

properties.name: DART+ West
properties.timeline: DART+ West will electrify and expand frequent rail service from Maynooth and the M3 Parkway to Dublin city centre, with enabling works expected from 2026.
properties.description: DART+ West extends Dublin’s electrified suburban rail network west to Maynooth and the M3 Parkway through the existing northern city approach.
milestones: Railway design received statutory approval in 2024
Part of the program expanding the DART network beyond 150 km
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Dublin city centre–Maynooth/M3 Parkway corridor; track, station, and electrification works are schematic.

properties.name: DART+ South West
properties.timeline: DART+ South West will expand and electrify the Kildare line from Hazelhatch and Celbridge to Dublin city centre as part of the DART+ program.
properties.description: The south-western DART+ project will bring more frequent electrified rail service to Hazelhatch, Celbridge, Clondalkin, and the western approach to Dublin.
milestones: Part of the wider DART+ network program
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Hazelhatch–Celbridge–Dublin corridor; final station, track, and electrification geometry is schematic.

properties.name: DART+ Coastal North
properties.timeline: DART+ Coastal North will expand and electrify the coastal rail corridor from Drogheda to Dublin city centre, improving capacity and frequency.
properties.description: The Coastal North project extends the DART model north through Malahide, Balbriggan, and Drogheda while upgrading the existing Dublin coastal route.
milestones: Drogheda–city centre corridor included in DART+
Frequent modern service planned for coastal communities
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Dublin–Malahide–Balbriggan–Drogheda corridor; final track and station geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Cork Area Commuter Rail Programme Phase 1
properties.timeline: Phase 1 includes Cork Kent platform works, the Glounthaune–Midleton twin-track project, and signalling upgrades scheduled for completion in 2026.

milestones: Cork signalling and communications upgrade included
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Cork Kent–Glounthaune–Midleton commuter corridor; phase-one rail works are represented schematically.

properties.name: Utrecht Merwedelijn

properties.timeline: The proposed tram between Utrecht and Nieuwegein has a provisional preference for a sunken route toward Westraven, with a formal decision expected no earlier than late 2026.
properties.description: The Merwedelijn would provide a high-capacity tram connection from Utrecht Centraal through the growing Merwedekanaalzone toward Nieuwegein and future southern development.

Public reaction and formal decision process continuing in 2026
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Utrecht Centraal–Merwedekanaalzone–Westraven/Nieuwegein corridor; mode, route, and stop geometry remain subject to decision.

properties.name: Brno Tram Line 1 to Kamechy
properties.agency: Dopravní podnik města Brna / City of Brno
properties.timeline: The 1.4 km Line 1 extension to Kamechy includes three new stops and a completed tunnel breakthrough, with first passengers planned for late 2027.
properties.description: Brno is extending tram Line 1 from Bystrc toward the Kamechy housing area, including the Ruda, Říčanská, and Kamechy stops.

properties.name: The Hague Koningscorridor
properties.agency: Gemeente Den Haag / Metropolitan Region Rotterdam The Hague
properties.timeline: The planned high-quality transit corridor would connect Scheveningen and the International Zone through Den Haag Centraal and Binckhorst toward Voorburg, Zoetermeer, or Delft.
properties.description: The Koningscorridor is a long-term high-capacity transit project for The Hague’s central and eastern growth areas, complementing RandstadRail and existing tram corridors.

Further western/eastern extensions remain under study
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Scheveningen–Den Haag Centraal–Binckhorst–Voorburg corridor; mode and final alignment remain under study.

properties.name: Charleroi Metro M5 Extension to Les Viviers

Electrical and signaling works scheduled in 2026

properties.name: Lausanne Metro M3

properties.timeline: The planned third metro line will connect Lausanne station and the city centre with the northern Blécherette district; the station interface and route concept are being refined.

Northern Blécherette connection remains the core objective

Pont Anne-de-Bretagne works support the line

Shared bridge and interchange works underway

Cais do Sodré works tracked through monthly reports
Final systems and finishing works continuing in 2026

Seven pairs of accessible stops planned

Inquiry held from May to June 2026
